topic: OEM & private label: custom filament for your broom and brush brand
caption:
Do you have your own broom or brush brand and want bristles that truly match your product's character? At Indofilament, filament can be made custom (OEM) and private label, from color and diameter to length and stiffness. The color range is complete, including our Gold series with a pearl finish. The main material is nylon from recycled plastic raw materials, so it stays eco-friendly.

Before mass production, you can request a sample to test the results. Our factory in Tangerang is also open for visits from brand owners, distributors, and importers.

Request a sample via WhatsApp +62 831-6591-3330 or DM us now.
